response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced generalist with strong web, DLang, and Node.js/TypeScript credentials, but he does not meet the core mandatory requirements: his professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, he shows no Windows-platform C++ depth, no SQL Server/Oracle experience, and no Fixed Income or capital-markets domain background. His fintech exposure at RIDE Capital is adjacent at best and does not substitute for investment-banking domain knowledge paired with strong C++.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured software engineering career with low-latency systems experience (DLang at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, DevOps tooling
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops, talks, and course creation
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months in 2014–2015), far short of the mandatory 5–10 years
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; database background is MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: Lack of required C++ depth on Windows
No capital markets / fixed income domain expertise
Strong general engineering and performance-systems background
